hero.heading: Streamline support with a modern ticket system
hero.supporting: Organize, assign, and resolve requests from one place—so your team stays in sync and nothing slips through.

plans.heading: Try free for a week, then stay simple at $5
plans.supporting: Start with a 7-day free trial, then continue on Standard (up to 50 users)—monthly or annual. Need more users? Contact us to negotiate.

trial.name: Free trial
trial.description: Full access to try DeskNin with your team before you commit.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: Everything you need to run support day to day—for teams of up to 50 users.

unlimited.name: Unlimited users
unlimited.description: For companies that need more than 50 users. Contact us to negotiate a plan that fits your scale.

contact.heading: Talk with us
contact.supporting: Questions about DeskNin, early access, or unlimited users for your company? Message us on WhatsApp and we will get back to you.
contact.whatsappMessage: Hi DeskNin! I’d like to learn more.
contact.negotiateMessage: Hi DeskNin! I’d like to negotiate an unlimited-users plan.

features.heading: Everything your support team needs
features.supporting: From intake to resolution, DeskNin keeps requests organized so your team can focus on people—not spreadsheets.

items.title: Ticket workflow
items.description: Capture, prioritize, and close requests with a clear status path your whole team understands.

items.title: Roles & assignment
items.description: Give admins, agents, and viewers the right access, then assign work to the person who should own it.

items.title: Email notifications
items.description: Keep customers and teammates updated when tickets move—without chasing status in chat threads.

items.title: Built for global teams
items.description: Set country, timezone, and support language at onboarding so your workspace matches how you operate.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.supporting: Quick answers about trial, pricing, and how DeskNin fits your team.

items.question: What happens after the free trial?
items.answer: The 7-day trial gives full access to try DeskNin. When it ends, choose Standard (monthly or annual) or contact us if you need more than 50 users.

items.question: How many users are included in Standard?
items.answer: Standard includes up to 50 users. If your company needs more, the Unlimited users plan is negotiated with our team.

items.question: Can I pay yearly?
items.answer: Yes. Standard is $5 per month or $50 per year—saving $10 compared with paying month to month.

items.question: Which languages does DeskNin support?
items.answer: The product site is available in English, Portuguese (Brazil), and Spanish. You also choose a default support language during onboarding.

items.question: Is my workspace data isolated?
items.answer: Each company gets its own workspace with role-based access for admins and agents. We design DeskNin for multi-tenant isolation from day one.

finalCta.heading: Ready to streamline support?
finalCta.supporting: Create your workspace in minutes and try DeskNin free for one week.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how DeskNin collects, uses, and protects information when you use our website and onboarding forms.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you start onboarding, we may collect company details, admin contact information, country, timezone, preferred support language, plan selection, and optional website or phone number. We also collect basic technical data such as browser type and pages visited for site reliability.

sections.heading: How we use information
sections.body: We use this information to provision your workspace, respond to sales or support inquiries, improve the product, and communicate about your account or trial.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell personal information. We may share data with infrastructure providers that help us host and operate DeskNin, under agreements that protect confidentiality.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: We retain onboarding and account information for as long as needed to provide the service and meet legal obligations. You may request deletion of onboarding data by contacting us.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of the DeskNin website and early access / onboarding experience.

sections.heading: Service
sections.body: DeskNin provides ticket management software. Features, pricing, and availability may change as we expand the product. Trial access is offered for evaluation and may end automatically after seven days.

sections.heading: Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for accurate onboarding information and for keeping admin credentials secure. You must use DeskNin in compliance with applicable laws and without abusing the service.

sections.heading: Plans and billing
sections.body: Standard is limited to 50 users and may be billed monthly or annually. Unlimited-user plans require a separate commercial agreement. Fees are listed in USD unless otherwise stated.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
sections.body: The website and early service are provided as available. To the fullest extent permitted by law, DeskNin disclaims warranties not expressly stated in a signed agreement.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these Terms can be sent to hello@desknin.com.
